reference_sql:
SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', observed_ts)) AS DATE) AS check_day,
       COUNT(*) AS checks
FROM competitor_prices
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', observed_ts)) AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-06-28' AND DATE '2025-07-04'
GROUP BY 1
alternatives: SELECT date_trunc('day', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', observed_ts))) AS check_day, COUNT(*) AS checks FROM competitor_prices WHERE timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', observed_ts)) >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-28 00:00:00' AND timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', observed_ts)) < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-05 00:00:00' GROUP BY 1

SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', observed_ts)) AS DATE) AS check_day, COUNT(*) AS checks FROM competitor_prices WHERE observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-27 22:00:00' AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-04 22:00:00' GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', observed_ts)) AS DATE) AS check_day, COUNT(*) AS checks FROM competitor_prices WHERE observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-27 22:00:00' AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-04 22:00:00' GROUP BY 1

solver.query:
SELECT CAST((observed_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam' AS DATE) AS check_day, COUNT(*) AS checks
FROM competitor_prices
WHERE CAST((observed_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam' AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-06-28' AND DATE '2025-07-04'
GROUP BY 1
